_description: Track the strongest triple and run combinations with the Metin2 Okey helper app. Download the mobile app, or play the web test mode to learn the game better.
_keywords: metin2 okey, metin2 okey helper, metin2 okey combination, metin2 okey play online, sogepps metin2 okey
hero_lead: Track the tiles left in play more accurately while you play Metin2 Okey, so you never miss the highest-scoring combinations available. Switch to the web test mode any time to learn the game step by step.
how_title: How to Use the Metin2 Okey Helper
how_desc: The app's goal is not to play the game for you, but to help you follow it more consciously.
how_1_d: Close off the tiles that appear or that you use in the helper board. This clears up the remaining pool.
how_2_d: The strongest runs and triple sets that can still be formed from the remaining tiles are listed by score.
how_3_d: Prioritize the highest-scoring combinations to build a more stable scoring plan.
how_4_d: On the Play on Web page you can run simulations with the same scoring rules and get in some practice.
feat_desc: The mobile app was designed to make combination tracking easier, especially in fast-paced rounds.
f_1_d: Keeps the most valuable moves, like a 100-point 6-7-8 same-color run, at the top based on the remaining tiles.
f_2_d: 123-678 run points, mixed-run points and triple n-n-n points are all calculated with the same logic.
f_3_d: No clutter of menus; a screen built for quick decisions at a glance during the game.
f_4_d: An educational test area, separate from the mobile experience, giving extra support to anyone who wants to learn the game.
